text:
mira_support: @acme_ops can you paste a minimal request that shows the external action being skipped?
acme_ops: Sending now — behavior started after last weekend's model variant swap (we moved to redwood-labs/qa:2 -> redwood-serve/v3.1). app log excerpt: `request_id=r-0a1b2c3d status=200 action=generate_text outcome=NO_ACTION`
mira_support: thanks, can you also share the request payload you send to our API?
acme_ops: here's a scrubbed example (removed PII):
```json
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-qa-v3.1",
  "input": "Summarize order and call order_service.create(order) with payload",
  "tools": [{"name":"order_service.create","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"string"},"items":{"type":"array"}}}}],
  "max_tokens": 256
}
```
mira_support: and the response you got?
acme_ops: we get a normal text output but the action field is absent, or sometimes present but with mangled args: `params` becomes `"{\"order_id\": \"123\"}"` (stringified JSON) or keys shuffled so validations fail. Example: 
```json
200 OK
{
  "id":"resp-9f2",
  "output":"Sure, here's the summary...",
  "action": null
}
```
jamie_eng_runtime: pinging eng-runtime, this sounds like an output-parsing/serialization regression in the postprocessing step after the rollout. any trace ids from our side?
mira_support: request_id r-0a1b2c3d (from acme logs) maps to our routing id `rid=rt-77b` in the request logs. I pulled the trace segment: `rid=rt-77b model=redwood-qa-v3.1 route=us-west-2 variant=canary-1`
suman_eng_ml: quick question — did the customer enable function/agent hooks or are they using inline tool schemas?
acme_ops: using explicit `tools` list and relying on model to emit `action` object (we used this pattern fine on v2.0). No hooks on our side.
jamie_eng_runtime: ok repro attempt: I replayed the request against canary-1 locally. I see model tokens that include a JSON action, but our postprocessor sometimes treats the JSON as raw text when certain token offsets include non-utf whitespace. Example snippet from generation tokens: `..."action": {
  "name": "order_service.create",
  "params": \"{\\\"order_id\\\": \\\"123\\\"}\n}` — note params is quoted inside the model output. Looks like the model started stringifying nested JSON for safety.
devon_prod: is this a model behavior change (model now wraps params as string) or an inference runtime bug that alters quotes?
suman_eng_ml: could be model-level safety heuristic that serializes nested objects to avoid accidental eval. But we didn't see it in prior model version. Need to check the model onboarding notes for v3.1.
jamie_eng_runtime: also capturing a runtime anomaly: when sequence length > 512 and KV cache split occurs across workers, our reassembly step occasionally loses braces around nested outputs. I'm attaching a short log:
```
[2026-02-28T14:02:11Z] rid=rt-77b fragment=0 tokens=..."params": "{\"order_id\":\"123\"\n[2026-02-28T14:02:11Z] rid=rt-77b fragment=1 tokens=...\"}"
```
jamie_eng_runtime: that suggests fragmentation boundaries are inserting or moving quotes. I'm escalating to infra with the fragment reassembly routine.
oncall_bot: @oncall_eng_runtime assigned (pager dings).
mira_support: can we give the customer a short-term mitigation?
jamie_eng_runtime: yes — two options: 1) pin them to the prior model series (redwood-qa-v2.x) until we patch reassembly; 2) ask them to set `tool_mode: passthrough` (server will return raw model tokens as text and skip reassembly) — both are config toggles.
suman_eng_ml: also working on fast patch: adjust the model postprocessor to attempt JSON extraction with tolerant parser (accept stringified JSON and try to parse it). This reduces breakage where model emits `params` as a string. Patch candidate ready for canary testing.
acme_ops: appreciate the workaround. We can pin to v2 for the next 48h and test the tolerant parser on a canary tenant.
mira_support: created support ticket #SUP-2981 and added steps to repro with exact payload. Escalating to eng-runtime and eng-ml for root cause.
jamie_eng_runtime: adding logs: `rt-77b` shows 3 fragments, fragment 2 missing leading brace — hypothesis: a race in feed ordering when multiple GPUs respond and the merge function doesn't preserve absolute token index ordering under high concurrency. I pushed a temporary guard to reassemble by token index; will deploy to canary later today.
suman_eng_ml: I'll deploy tolerant JSON extractor to canary after jamie's guard goes in. If both pass on canary we'll ship to stable.
devon_prod: notifying account team so they can update acme_ops. Also logged potential SLA hit for last weekend's rollout window.
acme_ops: quick Q — will billing be impacted if we pin to v2 (we worry about rate limits / quota differences)?
mira_support: short-term: no billing changes; pin just changes model selection, usage still billed as normal. If any quotas block we'll fast-track override.
oncall_bot: incident note saved to #incidents ref INC-2026-045
jamie_eng_runtime: next steps: 1) deploy reassembly guard to canary (ETA 2h), 2) deploy tolerant JSON extractor to canary (ETA 4h), 3) run regression suite and repro tests, 4) allow acme to test on canary, 5) rollout to stable if green.
mira_support: leaving this thread open for updates, will ping when canary tests complete. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
